config.autoSubmitPrompts: When on, action prompts (Continue workflow, Ask Kiro, custom actions) are sent to the Kiro chat immediately. When off (default), the prompt is pasted into the chat input for you to review and send with Enter.
config.customActions: Custom action rows shown in the AI-DLC Actions view. Each entry has a `label` (shown in the list), a `prompt` (copied to Kiro when clicked), and `newSession` (whether to open a fresh Kiro session). Add or edit them here, or use the "Add custom action…" row in the panel.
config.customActions.id: Auto-generated stable identifier. Leave empty for new entries.
config.customActions.label: Text shown for this action in the Actions list.
config.customActions.prompt: The prompt handed to Kiro (copied to the clipboard) when the action is clicked.
config.customActions.newSession: Open a fresh Kiro session before handing over the prompt.
